name: AIFT
description: AI forensic triage tool that parses disk images and other evidence, then has a model analyse the artefacts against your question.
whatItDoes: Lets analysts load evidence, state what they suspect and receive a triage report highlighting relevant artefacts. It is meant to speed up the first pass of an investigation.
howItWorks: Evidence is parsed with the Dissect framework into artefact tables selected by a profile. Those artefacts and the investigator's prompt go to the configured model for analysis. It can be driven from a local web interface, a CLI for automation, a REST interface or an MCP server.

requirements.name: AI provider
requirements.description: Configured in the GUI or config/config.yaml; a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint also works

models: Claude, OpenAI, Kimi, local OpenAI-compatible endpoints
